SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory AS product_group, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar c ON c.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND c.fiscal_period = 3
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN c.period_start_date AND c.period_end_date
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, p.subcategory
